comparison.objective: Carry a hot drink slowly through a restricted zone; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Stable transport with speed control versus recessed-tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, bounded tightening, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Mug reaches tray while remaining below 10 cm/s in the slow zone versus repeated non-bottoming stops without drift or damage.
comparison.reason: Transport safety and velocity compliance are meaningfully different from tuning and retaining a dynamic damping setting.
